Portronics TriFusion Portable Speaker – Smart 16W Bluetooth Speaker with Wireless Charging

The Portronics TriFusion Portable Speaker is an all-in-one smart audio solution designed for modern lifestyles. Combining powerful sound, ambient lighting, smart clock features, and wireless charging, this premium 16W Bluetooth Speaker delivers more than just music. With a sleek black finish, advanced Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, and immersive 360° RGB LED lighting, it transforms your room into a smart entertainment hub.

Whether you are relaxing, working, or winding down for the night, the offers crystal-clear audio, functional convenience, and elegant aesthetics. Its compact and stylish design makes it ideal for bedrooms, living rooms, offices, or bedside tables.

Powerful 16W Sound with Bluetooth 5.3

Experience rich bass and balanced sound with this engineered for immersive audio output. Powered by the latest Bluetooth 5.3 technology, the speaker ensures faster pairing, stable connectivity, and low latency across smartphones, tablets, laptops, and smart devices. Enjoy uninterrupted music streaming within a wide wireless range.

360° RGB LED Light for Ambient Mood

The integrated 360 RGB LED Light enhances your listening experience by creating a soothing or party-ready atmosphere. Multiple lighting modes sync beautifully with your space, making the perfect for both relaxation and entertainment. The soft glow also works well as a bedside lamp or night light.

Digital Clock with Alarm & Built-In White Noise

This smart speaker goes beyond audio by featuring a clear Digital Clock with Alarm, allowing you to manage your daily routine effortlessly. The built-in white noise feature helps improve sleep quality by masking background disturbances, making it an excellent choice for light sleepers, kids’ rooms, and wellness-focused spaces.

15W Wireless Charging Output

Say goodbye to cable clutter with the integrated Wireless Charging Output: 15W. Simply place your Qi-enabled smartphone on top of the speaker and enjoy fast, safe, and efficient charging. The functions as a speaker, clock, and wireless charger – all in one compact device.

Portable Design with 5 Hours Playtime

Designed for convenience, this offers up to 5 hours of playtime on a single charge, making it suitable for indoor use, small gatherings, or personal listening sessions. Its lightweight build and sturdy construction ensure durability while maintaining portability.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Output Power: 16W Bluetooth Speaker
  • Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.3
  • Lighting: 360° RGB LED Light
  • Display: Digital Clock with Alarm
  • Sound Modes: Built-in White Noise
  • Wireless Charging Output: 15W
  • Battery Playtime: Up to 5 Hours
  • Color: Black

Why Choose Portronics TriFusion?

The stands out among wireless speakers due to its multifunctional design. It is ideal for users looking for a Bluetooth speaker with RGB lights, a speaker with wireless charging, or a bedside speaker with table clock and alarm. This versatile device reduces the need for multiple gadgets while enhancing convenience and aesthetics. If you are searching for a premium with smart features, elegant design, and reliable performance, the is the perfect choice for your home or office setup.
